title: hDOM-toolkit: single-molecule genome mapping, structural-variant confidence, and SEM contour measurement
description: Three tools from a single study of single-molecule genome mapping. hdom assigns molecules to chromosomal loci from two-channel optical maps, re-ranking candidates by a windowed backbone correlation multiplied by a label-set F1. sv_confidence decides whether an inversion or translocation in one molecule is supported, importing hdom's scoring engine rather than reimplementing it. sem_length traces and measures DNA contours in SEM images. The aligner maligner (Mendelowitz et al., GPL v3) is bundled so the pipelines run without a separate build. Includes a two-chromosome example that runs anywhere and a genome-wide example against all 47 HG002 chromosome maps, published as a separate file in this record.
